regions.text: 任格を槽びた現實である。單なる現實として歳れの如く現在の瞬間に現象する。

quote.translation: Contingency is the actual that bears as its character the nothingness of impossibility, appearing as the merely actual in the present instant as though in play.

regions.text: 現在の「今」現象した離接肢の現賞性の背景に無を目睹して驚異するのが偶然である。

quote.translation: Chance is this: to witness nothingness behind the actuality of a disjunct that has appeared in the present "now", and to wonder at it.

regions.text: さうして驚異の情緒は實存にとつて運命を通告する。

quote.translation: The emotion of wonder, in turn, announces fate to Existenz.

regions.text: なほ可能離接肢の全體は膝義において形而上絕對者を意味し、形而上絶對者はその具體性において「必然上偶然者として開明される。

quote.translation: The whole of the possible disjuncts, moreover, signifies in the eminent sense the metaphysical absolute, and the metaphysical absolute is illuminated in its concreteness as the "necessary-contingent entity".

regions.text: また絕對者と有限者とを繋ぐものが運命である限り運命もまた「必然ー偶然者の性格を擔つて實存の中核を震域するのである。

quote.translation: And insofar as what joins the absolute and the finite is fate, fate too carries the character of the "necessary-contingent entity" and shakes Existenz to its core.

regions.text: 必然偶然の相開が有と無との相開に基くことを會得することが、偶然性に開する知見の根柢をなさなければならぬ。

quote.translation: To grasp that the correlation of the necessary and the contingent rests on the correlation of being and nothingness must form the foundation of our knowledge of contingency.

regions.text: 要するに定言偶然の核心意味は「個物および個々の事象」といぶことであつた。假説的偶然の核心的意味は「一の系列と他の系列との選近」こいふことであつた。離接的偶然の核心約意味は「無いことの可能」といふことであつた。

quote.translation: In sum, the core meaning of categorical contingency was "the individual thing and the individual event"; the core meaning of hypothetical contingency was "the Encounter of one series with another series"; and the core meaning of disjunctive contingency was "the possible of not being".

regions.text: 個物および個々の事象であるが故に、一般機念に對して偶然的徴表を備へてゐたのである。

quote.translation: It was because it is an individual thing and an individual event that the contingent bore contingent marks over against the general concept.

regions.text: 獨立した系列と系列との選遍であるが故に、理由と踏糖の必然的開係の外にあつたのである。

quote.translation: It was because it is the Encounter of one independent series with another that it stood outside the necessary relation of ground and consequent.

regions.text: 無いことの可能なるが故に、講可能性全體の有つ必

quote.translation: And it was because it is the possible of not being that it ran counter to the necessity belonging to the whole of possibilities.
